title: Supabase Batch Runtime / Scheduling
summary: Supabase Cron 已驗證 Database Function scheduling，以及 Cron → pg_net → Edge Function → Native Data API → external API → synthetic update 的 scheduled runtime chain。正式結案前仍需補 parameterized invocation：Cron 對 Edge Function 傳入固定參數與 execution-time 動態參數。複雜參數準備若需要查 DB 或 business rules，應由 launcher / preparation API 處理，不把 orchestration logic 塞進 Cron。
flow: Verified: Cron → Database Function; Cron → Edge Function → synthetic Data API Read/Update → Open-Meteo → synthetic SUCCESS update. Remaining Cron gate: fixed + dynamic runtime parameters in scheduled HTTP invocation. Backend Service DB Access is tracked separately as C-BSA-1.
